items.briefing:
Australia and New Zealand are experiencing a surge in critical software vulnerabilities, with attackers increasingly using AI to launch cyberattacks faster and at greater scale. July saw a notable rise in ransomware and cyberattacks globally, and while the number of ransomware victims has plateaued, the number of active criminal groups is at a record high — meaning organisations remain firmly in the crosshairs. A serious flaw in widely used VMware vCenter software is also being actively exploited worldwide, so IT teams should check whether their systems are patched.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT support team to confirm that all server software — especially VMware products — is fully up to date.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Patch backlogs leaving Australian organisations critically exposed to high-impact security flaws.
